jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- Software Applications
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applications**

  

At Oxford Instruments Andor we are devoted to accelerating the greatest scientific advancements of our age. It matters to us that the products we develop make a real difference to our customers and contribute significantly to their research. We want to deliver differentiated, accessible solutions to the widest possible scientific research and industrial communities. We are a market leading organisation with a diverse and inclusive environment.  



Following an internal promotion we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applicationswill work in the Software team as part of the wider Engineering \& Technology Department.

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications used to control and run experiments on scientific instrumentation. Working primarily with C\#, .NET and related technologies, you will contribute to software solutions that control hardware, acquire and process scientific data, and provide advanced data visualisation and analysis capabilities.

  

This is a hands\-on software engineering role supporting multiple products and projects across Andor's portfolio. You will work closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver robust, maintainable and high\-quality software that enables customers to achieve groundbreaking scientific results.

  

Key responsibilities include:

  

* Design, develop, maintain and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications using C\# and .NET.
* Contribute to the delivery of software across multiple products and projects within the Software Applications portfolio.
* Develop software that interfaces with scientific instrumentation and hardware devices for experiment control and automation.
* Implement solutions for data acquisition, processing, storage and analysis.
* Contribute to the development of data visualisation capabilities, including advanced 3D and 4D rendering and scientific imaging applications.
* Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues and customer\-reported problems.
* Participate in software design discussions and contribute to architecture and technical decision\-making.
* Write clean, maintainable and testable code in accordance with engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the development team.
* Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers, product managers and domain experts to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Support software releases, deployment activities and ongoing product maintenance.
* Share technical knowledge and support colleagues through collaboration and peer review.
* Occasional travel to other offices and customer sites

  

The Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applicationswill have:

  

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline or equivalent professional experience in delivering commercial software solutions
* At least 5 years' experience in commercial software development.
* Significant hands\-on experience developing applications using C\# and .NET.
* Proven experience delivering complex software solutions through the full software development lifecycle.
* Experience working within Agile software development teams.
* Experience developing and supporting commercial desktop software applications.

  

This permanent position is based at our Belfast headquarters working a hybrid model.

  

Informal enquiries may be directed to Louise Dooley Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist via email to louise.dooley@oxinst.com

  

Please apply via this link: Andor Technology \- Oxford Instruments Careers (oxinst.com)

Please note on this occasion we are unable to provide sponsorship for visa applicants for this particular post, as such applicants must hold the right to work in the UK to be eligible.

  



**Why Oxford Instruments Andor?**

  

Our company values of being Inclusive, Innovative, Trusted and Purposeful are at the core of everything we do for our customers and our teams. At Oxford Instruments Andor, our employees are fundamental to our business success and we are delighted to provide a competitive and comprehensive benefits programme with a range of options to suit your lifestyle.

  

**UK Oxford Instruments** **Andor Benefits:**


Oxford Instruments Andor provides employees with a competitive compensation \& benefits package to suit your lifestyle.


* Health \& Wellbeing\- Mental Health First Aiders, Employee Assistance Programme (LifeWorks, Babylon and UnMind), Private Medical Insurance with BUPA for you and your dependents, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Personal Accident Insurance. Company sick pay and medical leave, Occupational healthcare Service, 2 days paid leave for volunteering each year
* Money \& Lifestyle –Pension – employer contributory scheme (6%), Share Incentive Plan, Leave Purchase Scheme, Cycle to Work scheme, Car Salary Exchange Scheme, Tech Purchase scheme. Give as You Earn. Employee discount scheme. Free Parking Onsite.
* Career –Externally accredited training and development opportunities including support with professional qualifications, Service awards, LinkedIn learning, Learning \& development programmes.
* Work Life Balance – 187\.5 holiday hours, 9 customary holidays. Flexible start and finish times, lunchtime finish on Fridays, Enhanced maternity pay, Enhanced paternity pay, Bereavement leave

  

**Oxford Instruments Andor**

  

Oxford Instruments Andor is the global leader in the pioneering and manufacturing of high\-performance light measuring solutions, bringing together the latest developments in sensors, electronics, optics and software. Our ground\-breaking low light imaging cameras, spectroscopy solutions and microscopy systems are being used to develop cures for cancer, explore deeper into space and examine clean energy sources. **What is the Role?**



As a WTG O\&M Engineer, you’ll play a key role at the heart of the Dogger Bank Operations \& Maintenance team—supporting one of the world’s most significant offshore wind projects. This is a unique opportunity to be involved from the early commissioning stages through to long\-term operations, giving you full lifecycle exposure to turbine performance and reliability.



In the early phase, you’ll take ownership of turbine commissioning, acceptance, and handover—ensuring each asset meets the highest standards before entering service. As the wind farm transitions into full operations, your focus will shift toward maintenance strategy, fault diagnosis, and performance optimisation, helping maximise energy output and asset reliability.



This is a hands\-on and highly collaborative role, combining offshore field support with data\-driven engineering. You’ll work closely with OEMs, contractors, and internal stakeholders, influencing technical decisions and driving continuous improvement across the fleet.


**You will**


* Lead turbine acceptance, commissioning, and handover activities while ensuring compliance with contractual, corporate, regulatory, and internal standards across the fleet, providing hands\-on field support where required.

* Track and manage engineering defects, working closely with OEMs and stakeholders to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

**You have**

* A qualification of HND level in an engineering or relevant experience in wind turbine, major components or rotational plant.
* Experience of technical support delivery including management of refurbishment activities for major components including root cause analysis.

jobs.description:
Wood is delighted to present an exciting Graduate Development Opportunity within our Measurement \& Hydrocarbon team, offering a unique platform for a highly motivated and ambitious graduate to enhance their technical capabilities, gain valuable industry exposure, and embark on a rewarding and progressive career within the energy sector.


This is an Aberdeen\-based role, with a minimum of three days per week at the Client office, Aberdeen, and the remaining two days at Sir Ian Wood House, Aberdeen. Additional days at the Client office may occasionally be required to support holiday or sickness cover.


***\#LI\-Hybrid***

**The Role**

In this position, you will shadow our experienced Hydrocarbon Allocation Engineer. Your core responsibility will be to assist in the provision of accurate daily flow measurement totals to both internal and external stakeholders. Your work will maintain the daily and monthly production allocation process for the client asset.


This job ensures correct hydrocarbon accounting, production reporting, metering validation, data correction, and compliance. Through Energy Builder and related metering systems, you will support financial reporting, partner allocations, regulatory obligations, and daily production operations.


This is not only a fantastic learning opportunity, but also a chance to work directly within a fast\-paced operations environment. This opportunity is designed to help build technical skills in hydrocarbon measurement and accountancy, while gaining invaluable business insight into the internal workings of an oil and gas operator.


Graduates would hope to gain experience in hydrocarbon accounting and metering, validation of production data, operating Energy Builder allocation systems, managing fiscal metering corrections, conducting production reconciliations and mismeasurements, issuing partner allocation reports, and delivering accurate daily and monthly hydrocarbon accounts.


**Our Clients and Projects**

**Designing the future. Transforming the world.**

Our Production Optimisation team are part of our Digital consulting business unit. We support our clients to secure economic recovery from existing infrastructure, optimising assets and enabling extension of productive field life whilst accelerating the move towards net Zero. The work we do predominately enables Energy security whilst we transition. However, we are also growing our services across Carbon Capture Utilisation and storage and transportation of Hydrogen and Ammonia.


With Wood’s ambitious growth within energy transition related business, you will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to our global pool of knowledge experts in a range of topics, including traditional oil and gas, CO *2* and H *2* transport.


Wood is an inclusive and diverse global community of inquisitive minds and recognised industry innovators, partnering to create new possibilities.
 

**What we can offer**

* **Meaningful and interesting projects** delivered to high profile clients across the Energy Sector within the UK and other international locations as required
* **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** ; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business
* **Competitive renumeration package** with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
* **Commitment to continued professional development** ; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests
* **Global connections** ; join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession

  
**Daily Data Management \& Allocation**

* Gathered and checked daily production, laboratory, and equipment reports to ensure information to Energy Builder
* Run hourly and daily allocation tracking to correctly split up and count total production
* Spot and fixed data errors to meet mass balance targets, generate and issue reports and XML files with partners

**Quality Control \& Problem Solving**

* Review data and identify total errors, equipment errors, system upsets, or unusual laboratory data
* Calculate and issue mismeasurement reports
* Check and verify allocation data across oil, gas, water, and injection systems to ensure plant balanced

**System \& Software Management**

* Daily use of Energy Builder, including updating well statuses, storage data, and cargo details
* Run key calculations for hourly, daily, and monthly production reports and verification checks
* Keep clear auditable records for measurement and allocation

**Hydrocarbon Accounting \& Finance Support**

* Monitor plant operations, oil and gas measurement and overall mass balances daily
* Managed Bill of Lading (BOL) shipping reviews to support production and scheduling teams

**Teamwork \& Communication**

* Connected offshore operations, lab teams, measurement technicians, and business partners
* Distributed regular allocation updates, balance sheets, and monthly financial reports
* Offered fast technical help whenever tracking or measurement problems came up

**Technical Skills \& Expertise Developed**

* Mastered tracking oil, gas, and water production using mass balance, uncertainty and mismeasurement calculations
* Learned to manage financial\-grade (fiscal) metering systems and measurement errors
* Developed knowledge of tank inventory, cargo records, and offshore production workflows

**Systems \& Software Knowledge**

* Databases \& Allocation: Energy Builder, Oracle, and production reporting databases
* Data Analytics: PI Process Book, PI Datalink, and advanced Microsoft Excel
* Specialised Tools: FLOCALC (Kelton), instrumentation systems, and Adobe Acrobat

  
**What makes you remarkable?**

At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.
 

Expected:


* Recent graduate engineer with a minimum 2:1 bachelor’s degree (BEng or MEng) in an Engineering discipline preferred
* Industry experience is preferable
* Demonstrate initiative, and have good communication skills
* Possess an ability to learn quickly and be adaptable and flexible to match business requirements
* Ability and desire to work in diverse and multi\-disciplinary team environments
* Must have the right to work in the UK

  
Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy \& Materials pillar of Sidara \- a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description:
**Job Requisition ID \#**


26WD100960
Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron\-based desktop platform. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

 **Responsibilities**

* **Test automation \- approximately 35%:** Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end\-to\-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
* **CI/CD and build automation \- approximately 30%:** Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows
* **Release qualification and automation \- approximately 20%:** Help automate Windows desktop packaging, code signing, publishing, installation validation, upgrade testing, and release\-candidate qualification
* **Troubleshooting and quality improvement \- approximately 15%:** Investigate build, test, installer, and application failures. Work with software engineers to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and implement or automate solutions
* Review product requirements and user stories to understand test scope, identify quality risks, and contribute to test plans
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
* Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
* Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
* Participate in release\-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
* Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues
* Improve flaky tests and unreliable pipeline stages to increase the quality of developer feedback
* Document build, test, and release procedures so they can be understood and maintained by the broader engineering team
* Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Software development or test automation experience using a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, C\#, Java, or similar
* Experience developing automated tests for software applications
* Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
* Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems
* Understanding of software testing practices including functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing
* Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers and other technical team members
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Windows desktop applications
* Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
* Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
* Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
* Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
* Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application\-startup scenarios
* Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments
* Familiarity with enterprise Windows environments, device\-management systems, corporate proxies, or restricted\-user configurations
* Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

 **The Ideal Candidate**


You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.


You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems, learning unfamiliar tools, asking questions when needed, and working with more experienced engineers on complex issues. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve the reliability of the team's development and release processes.


You also value the benefits of hybrid collaboration and are comfortable working regularly from Autodesk's Sheffield office while partnering with distributed teams across the company.

  

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web\-based products to deliver richer, higher\-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer\-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.


You will join a new cross\-functional platform team working across desktop application engineering, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, and software release.

**This is a hybrid working position based out of Autodesk's Sheffield office.** You will collaborate both in person with colleagues in Sheffield and remotely with engineering and partner teams across Autodesk.

**Learn More**

**About Autodesk**


Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency**


Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. **Belonging**  

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global\-belonging

This role may require in\-person onboarding and/or in\-person ID verification.

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

  

**Senior Software Engineer, Full\-Stack Applications – Ratings Technology**

  

Fitch Ratings is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to join our global Ratings Technology team in **Manchester**. This is your opportunity to not just build mission\-critical applications, but to **shape the future direction** of technology that powers how a world\-leading credit ratings agency delivers insights. Your leadership, architectural decisions, and vision will directly impact analysts, executives, and decision\-makers who shape global financial markets.


You'll work closely with our talented engineering teams supporting Ratings workflow and analytical applications, influencing both **technical architecture and organizational direction**. We're looking for a **seasoned technologist who thrives on challenging assumptions, experimenting with emerging technologies (especially AI), and pushing boundaries**—not an MLE or AI specialist, but a full\-stack engineer who's curious, unafraid to question the status quo, and excited to explore how AI can transform analytical workflows, as well as delivering high quality user experiences in their applications. This is a **critical role** for an organization expanding rapidly and building for the future, offering mobility and upward potential for the right visionary.

  

**What We Offer:**


* **Strategic leadership with organizational impact** – Shape technical architecture and product direction for applications used by analysts worldwide, with high visibility to senior leadership and the ability to influence technology strategy across Ratings Technology
* **Innovation\-first culture and experimentation** – Permission to challenge established patterns, explore emerging technologies including AI, and drive proof\-of\-concepts with access to cutting\-edge tools and a community that celebrates curiosity and bold thinking
* **Continuous learning and career growth** – Training, certifications, conferences, mentorship opportunities, and clear paths to principal/architect/leadership tracks as you establish yourself as a thought leader
* **Flexibility and world\-class environment** – Work from premier offices in London, Manchester, or Toronto with hybrid flexibility, competitive compensation reflecting your seniority, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values both innovation and work\-life harmony

  

**We'll Count on You To:**


* **Deliver technical excellence and build game\-changing solutions** – Design robust, scalable **full\-stack applications using Java/Springboot, C\#/.NET, Python and REACT**, drive architectural decisions, establish technical standards, and lead exploration of AI/ML integration opportunities that transform workflows
* **Offer influence and mentorship** – Partner with product managers, analysts, and senior stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, mentor engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and psychological safety
* **Challenge the status quo and drive innovation** – Question existing approaches, champion better solutions even when uncomfortable, experiment with emerging technologies, create proofs\-of\-concept, and push the organization toward what's possible rather than what's comfortable
* **Champion engineering excellence and quality** – Implement CI/CD pipelines, conduct architecture reviews, solve complex performance and scalability challenges, establish best practices that scale across teams, and balance innovation with pragmatic delivery
* **Shape organizational and team direction** – Influence team processes, lead strategic technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, bring fresh perspectives while respecting institutional knowledge, and model the curiosity, humility, and boldness needed across the organization
* **Own reliability and navigate complexity** – Provide expert troubleshooting for sophisticated issues, maintain system performance at scale, balance multiple strategic priorities, and deliver excellence in fast\-paced Agile environments

  

**What You Need to Have:**


* **Deep full\-stack engineering expertise** – 10\+ years of hands\-on experience building enterprise applications, with **expert\-level proficiency in Java/Springboot and/or C\#/.NET, good familiarity with Python, REACT** and modern web technologies in production environments.
* **Architectural mastery and technical depth** – Proven track record of designing maintainable, scalable systems; excellent understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and the ability to make architectural decisions and live with their consequences
* **Bachelor's degree** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* **Visionary problem\-solving and growth mindset** – Exceptional analytical abilities, demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, track record of experimentation and learning from failures, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives
* **Outstanding collaboration and communication skills** – Proven success with cross\-functional teams, ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, and emotional intelligence to navigate organizational dynamics

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**


* **Modern engineering practices and DevOps prowess** – Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and hands\-on cloud expertise with microservices and cloud\-native architecture
* **AI curiosity and exploration mindset** – Genuine interest in how AI/ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation could transform software delivery, business processes, systems and applications; experience experimenting with new technologies and evaluating practical applications; comfort with emerging technology ambiguity
* **Financial services domain expertise** – Experience with analytical workflows, regulatory processes, financial products, credit ratings, or understanding of how technology enables better decision\-making
* **Agile mastery and change agent experience** – Track record of establishing practices, challenging established patterns constructively, and creating space for teams to innovate and take calculated risks

  

**If you are a seasoned technologist with a passion for innovation, a desire to shape organizational direction, and the courage to question the status quo, we would love to hear from you!**

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**  

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* **A Culture of Learning \& Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning, financial wellness and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals
* **Promoting Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that prioritize a healthy body \& mind
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family\-first policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days and support for community engagement initiatives

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision\-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day\-to\-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI\-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

**Type:** Full\-time, permanent (40 hours per week \- Door to Door)

**The Opportunity**

Plenty of field service roles have you chasing whatever lands in the van that day \- a different make every visit, no manufacturer support, and a parts department that sees you as a nuisance. This one is different.

Our client is the specialist telehandler and roto hire division of one of the UK’s best\-known equipment rental groups. They do one thing \- telehandlers and rotating telehandlers \- and they do it properly. Their engineers are trained by the biggest manufacturers in the industry, their service vans are profiled for telehandlers and rotos only, and they fully service and maintain their own fleet on site rather than leaning on the manufacturers to do it for them.

They’re looking for a skilled Field Service Engineer to look after their machines and customers across the East Midlands. If you’re an experienced plant or agricultural fitter who wants to specialise, get manufacturer\-level training on the latest kit, and work for a business that openly says it invests heavily in its field engineers, this is well worth a conversation.

**About the Company**

Our client is a nationally recognised specialist in telehandler and roto hire, part of a listed specialist equipment rental group whose heritage goes back to 1954 and which celebrated its 70th anniversary in 2024\. The group turns over more than £350 million a year across a portfolio of specialist rental businesses serving infrastructure, construction, housebuilding, utilities and energy.

The division runs what it describes as the most diverse telehandler and roto fleet in the UK \- from compact 4m telehandlers right up to 35m rotating machines, alongside 7\.2 and 12 tonne heavy lift telehandlers, electric telehandlers and Teletruks. The fleet is built around the leading manufacturers, including JCB, Manitou and Merlo, so you’ll be working on modern, well\-maintained machines rather than tired kit that’s been run into the ground.

A depot network stretching from Aberdeen to Penzance means there’s nowhere in the UK they can’t reach, and a centralised hire and service desk handles enquiries nationwide \- giving engineers in the field real technical back\-up over the phone when they need it. Customers range from national housebuilders and main contractors to infrastructure and utilities clients, and many have been working with the business for years.

Safety is taken seriously too. The group’s approach is built around getting everyone home safe and healthy, with third\-party validation of how it manages risk, and it has had its net\-zero targets validated by the Science Based Targets initiative \- so you’ll see more electric and low\-emission machines coming through the fleet.

**The Role**

As Field Service Engineer, you’ll be the face of the business on customer sites across the East Midlands \- keeping hire machines working, getting broken\-down machines back to work quickly, and making sure customers want to hire again.

You’ll plan and manage your own workload, work closely with the service desk and wider operations team, and take ownership of the machines and customers on your patch. Expect a mix of planned servicing, breakdowns and fault\-finding across construction, housebuilding, infrastructure and utilities sites.

What you’ll be doing:

* Carrying out planned maintenance and servicing on hire telehandlers and rotos on customer sites
* Responding to breakdowns and delivering fast, effective repairs to keep customer downtime to a minimum
* Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults on site
* Acting as the frontline representative for the business, building strong, lasting relationships with customers
* Working with the service desk and wider operations teams to spot and deliver improvements to the service
* Keeping accurate records of every repair, service and customer interaction
* Managing your own diary and time effectively across a busy regional patch

**About You**

* Proven experience repairing and servicing plant equipment, including telehandlers \- essential
* A recognised mechanical qualification in plant or agricultural engineering (NVQ, City \& Guilds or equivalent) \- desirable
* Experience with rotating telehandlers, heavy lift machines or electric telehandlers is a bonus, but full training is provided
* A practical problem\-solver who uses their initiative and is confident working on their own
* A good communicator with a genuine customer service mindset
* Well organised, with experience of managing your own time and workload
* Happy to travel to customer sites across the region as required
* A valid UK driving licence

**What’s On Offer**

* Competitive salary
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to buy additional holiday
* Salary sacrifice pension
* Life assurance at 3x salary
* Share save scheme \- a real stake in the business you help grow
* Manufacturer\-led training on the latest telehandler and roto technology, plus structured in\-house and external training
* Access to the group’s online learning Academy for ongoing development
* Free tool hire from across the group
* Health cash plan at discounted premiums, eye care vouchers and gym discounts
* 24/7 accident helpline, cycle to work scheme and long service recognition
* Employee discount platform with savings at thousands of well\-known brands, plus discounts on HP products and EE mobile contracts
* Recommend a friend scheme
* The security of a long\-established, nationally recognised group, with genuine career progression across its specialist businesses

**How to Apply**

If you’re an experienced plant or telehandler engineer looking to specialise with a business that invests in its engineers and backs them properly in the field, we’d like to hear from you. Apply through Rommbic with your CV, or get in touch with us for a confidential conversation about the role.

Pay: £35,000\.00\-£38,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Company car
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Health \& wellbeing programme

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About the role** **Job Title**: Materials Engineer


**Location:** Aberdeen


**Project Type:** Civils / Energy


**Company:** Balfour Beatty Group



Balfour Beatty is a leading national infrastructure and construction company with more than a century of heritage in Scotland, delivering key projects that strengthen communities and improve national connectivity.



The Netherton Hub is a major new energy infrastructure development located near Peterhead in Aberdeenshire, forming a key part of SSEN Transmission’s multi‑billion‑pound **Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment (ASTI)** programme and its wider **Pathway to 2030** upgrade of the Scottish transmission network.



Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.



By joining the ASTI Netherton Hub project, candidates will gain hands‑on experience delivering one of the UK’s most significant energy programmes, developing advanced personal and professional skills, benefiting from long‑term career progression within a national framework, and playing a direct role in strengthening Scotland’s renewable‑powered future

 **What you'll be doing**  

The Materials Engineer will provide technical expertise and support across civil engineering projects, mainly a large earth moving project near Peterhead, ensuring compliance with specifications, standards, and regulatory requirements. This role is critical to maintaining quality assurance in materials testing and advising on material selection on the project.


* **Materials Testing \& Analysis**
* + Conduct laboratory and site\-based testing of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt in accordance with UKAS and project specifications.
	+ Interpret test results and provide technical reports to project teams.
* **Compliance \& Standards**
* + Ensure adherence to Balfour Beatty’s quality management systems and relevant British Standards.
	+ Support compliance with environmental and safety regulations, including IRR17 and Dangerous Goods Safety requirements.
* **Technical Support**
* + Advise project teams on material suitability, grading, and performance.
	+ Assist in troubleshooting and assist with materials issues
* **Documentation \& Reporting**
* + Prepare accurate records of tests, calibrations, and inspections.
	+ Contribute to risk assessments and method statements for laboratory and site operations.
* **Collaboration**
* + Work closely with Senior Materials Technician, and site engineers.
	+ Participate in weekly project review meetings and provide updates on material performance.

  

**Who we're looking for**  

#### **Skills \& Qualifications**


* Experience in materials testing within a construction or infrastructure environment.
* Knowledge of UKAS accreditation processes and relevant standards.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and report\-writing abilities.
* Confident leading audits and developing staff
* Full driving licence
* Health and safety conscientious on site and the laboratory

#### **Desirable**


* Membership of a professional body (e.g., ICE).
* Familiarity with environmental authorisations and radiation safety (advantageous for certain projects).
* Ability to manage workload across multiple projects.
* SSSTS qualified.

  

**Why work for us*** Be part of a major energy infrastructure investment that’s shaping the UK’s low\-carbon future.


* Work on challenging, high\-profile projects with the support of a skilled, multi\-disciplinary team.


* Join a culture of learning, improvement, and excellence—where your voice makes a difference.


* Enjoy a competitive salary, development opportunities, and a flexible, inclusive working environment.



Professional and personal development



The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.



We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.



We're proud of the Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified, our 70:20:10\* approach to development means we have a learning approach that suits everyone.


* 70% learning on the job, 20% learning from those around you, and 10% formal training courses and learning events.



For further information about Balfour Beatty Regional Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/careers/Scotland \- You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section

 **About us**  

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.



We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.



Our award\-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.



Diversity and inclusion



At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion



To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.



As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long\-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/



We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. If you have any feedback on the process, please share this with us at: candidaterecruitmentqueries@balfourbeatty.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**


Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.


We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

  



**Job Description**

  



Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Data Analysis Software


Uxbridge, West London, 4 days onsite, 1 day from home

  

Every commercial flight records thousands of parameters — control inputs, engine performance, altitude, warnings. When the aircraft lands, that data has to be retrieved, decoded and turned into something an airline's safety team can act on. We build the software that does it. Over 300 airlines use our ground systems, including most of the world's major carriers, alongside military operators. When an airline spots an unstable approach trend before it becomes an incident, our software is usually how they found it.

  

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team in Uxbridge that builds it.

  

What you'll actually do


You'll own features end to end — from design discussion through to release — across a stack that spans a mature .NET backend, Angular front ends, and Python tooling. Specifically:

* Design and build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of flight data, where performance and correctness genuinely matter
* Take technical ownership of a product area: make the architectural calls, and be the person the team asks about it
* Review other engineers' code and mentor two or three developers earlier in their careers
* Work with QA, product and the engineering lead across a normal Agile cycle — planning, standups, reviews, retros
* Help us modernise: we have a long\-lived .NET codebase with some older Windows service components, and part of this role is bringing it forward sensibly rather than rewriting for its own sake


What we need

* Around 4\+ years building production software commercially
* Strong C\#/.NET and solid relational database skills (we use MySQL)
* Comfortable working across the stack — you don't have to be a front\-end specialist, but you should be able to work in TypeScript/Angular when a feature needs it
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs
* Genuinely good at debugging: the ability to work out why a system is misbehaving from incomplete information
* Git and modern version control workflows


Useful, but we'll teach you

* Python
* AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS)
* Docker and CI/CD pipelines
* Automated testing frameworks
* Aviation or aerospace domain knowledge — almost nobody arrives with this, and we don't expect you to

  

You do not need to tick every box. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, apply.

  

What we offer

*As part of the wider Teledyne UK group, we offer our employees a range of company benefits that include:*

* + Salary sacrifice\-led pension plan that matches employee contributions up to 7%.
	+ Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
	+ Free life assurance cover at the value of four times basic annual salary.
	+ ⁠Salary sacrifice Electric \& Hybrid Vehicle car scheme
	+ 25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays.
	+ Holiday purchase scheme which enables employees to purchase an additional 5 days worth of annual leave each year.
	+ Company funded medical cash plan (MediCash) which allows eligible members to offset the cost of routine medical treatments.
	+ Internal reward and recognition scheme linked to internal benefits platform.
	+ Employee Assistance Programme.
	+ Comprehensive wellbeing programme that supports employees with their physical, mental and financial health, as well as their cultural/environmental wellbeing.
	+ Competitive employee discounts platform that provides employees with discounts with leading brands/retailers.
	+ Cycle to Work scheme.
	+ Enhanced family\-friendly benefits and policies.
	+ Company sick pay.
	+ Free Onsite parking
	+ Career development across the wider Teledyne group — a lot of our engineers have moved between teams, sites and disciplines
	+ Software that matters: what you ship affects how safely aircraft are operated

  

The commute, honestly


We're onsite four days a week with one day from home. We know that rules us out for some people. But if you live anywhere in West London, Hillingdon, Buckinghamshire or along the M4/M40, this is likely the shortest commute you'll find for a role at this level — Uxbridge is the end of the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, and there's parking. Several of our team took this job specifically to stop commuting into central London.

  

Interview process

* A Teams call with the hiring manager and site manager — informal, both ways
* An onsite session covering technical discussion and a paired programming task, plus competency\-based questions with our Head of Digital Solutions
* Offer

  

About Teledyne Controls


Since 1964 we've designed and manufactured aircraft data recording and management systems, working directly with airlines and with OEMs including Airbus and Boeing. Teledyne Controls Flight Data Company in Uxbridge is our principal UK office, where we develop the ground\-based software used to replay and analyse recorded flight data.

  



Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.


.

**Location**

Coventry, West Midlands (England), CV1 2WT : Manchester, North West England, M1 2WD : City of Westminster, London (region), SW1P 3BT**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


These are exciting times in the Department for Education.


Our digital services have been migrated onto public cloud and were on a journey of maturing our technology, and how we work, to take full advantage of cloud\-native and network technologies. Our goal is to make our digital delivery faster, cheaper and more secure.


Our diverse and inclusive culture in DfE reflects the society we live in \- this helps us to achieve better outcomes for all our users. We typically work in Agile teams, so we can innovate and radically improve services that: raise education standards and provide the best start in life for children; support disadvantaged and vulnerable children and young people; and drive economic growth.


If you are successful, you will be working in the Schools Digital portfolio. Our aim is to support schools and teachers to have the best environment, tools and support so that every child can achieve and thrive. We work with Schools Group to deliver Manifesto commitments on recruiting and retaining teachers, including the 6\.5k manifesto commitment, SEND reform and helping schools improve.


This is an exciting time to join the portfolio with significant reform programmes underway for SEND and schools, which will have a direct impact on the outcomes on the teaching landscape and help every child achieve and thrive.


We work in multi\-disciplinary teams using Agile methods to innovate and radically improve services that:

* Support schools to manage and improve their performance
* Support teachers and teacher trainee mentors to provide the best start in life for children
* Support children to get the best SEND support
* Drive economic growth
### **Job description**


As a Senior Technical Architect, your main responsibilities will include:

* Defining, maintaining, and championing the technical strategy for a service or group of services \- keeping up to date with the latest technologies and trends, whilst delivering working software early and often.
* Leading technical specialists in multiple projects and services, on problems that require broad architectural thinking.
* Defining how to build and operate user\-centred, open\-source web systems in an agile environment, to serve a variety of citizen and government needs.
* Being responsible for the technical design and development of services in your programme, including how they interact with their surroundings, and how they evolve over time.
* Challenging entrenched practices and influencing decision\-makers, looking for deeper underlying problems to solve, and larger opportunities for digital transformation.
* Communicating the vision for government services to developers and non\-developers alike, working in multi\-disciplinary teams that bring policy and delivery together.
* Playing an active role in the DfE architecture community, where you will share knowledge of tools and techniques, as well as joining related communities of practice and events where appropriate, such as product, user research, design, platforms, security, etc.
* Helping to build a diverse, inclusive culture across the technical architecture community.
* Working with your Lead Technical Architect, colleagues and peers on profession\-based activities (and cross\-profession), such as defining standards and guidance around best practice.
### **Person specification**

**Essential criteria:**


Applications will be assessed against the following criteria:


Assessed at application and both interview stages:

* Experience working and coaching in technical teams and delivering user\-centred services in an agile environment.
* Experience working with cloud\-first architectures and how to build applications that take advantage of the opportunities they offer.
* Experience of software development in C\# .Net (or similar), and introducing modern software engineering practices, such as Test\-Driven Development (TDD), continuous integration/development (CI/CD), automated deployment pipelines and version control with Git and DevOps.


Assessed at application and second interview stage:

* The ability to work with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to achieve agreement on technical plans.
* The ability to look beyond immediate technical problems and identify the wider implications.
* Practical knowledge at many levels of the web stack, from front\-end code, down to infrastructure and networking.

**Desirable criteria:**


The following criteria are desirable. Applicants evidence against these criteria will be used at interview in the event of a tie break situation, to make an informed decision:

* Experience using automated tests to continuously validate your work.
* Experience of applying the UK Government Service Standard and service assessment.
* Experience of mentoring and supporting colleagues in multi\-disciplinary teams, one\-to\-one or in groups.
* Ability to work with stakeholders to produce effective strategies for technology choices, using the most appropriate languages, frameworks and tools to meet user and business needs.
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £60,222, Department for Education contributes £17,446 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
Applicants currently holding a permanent post in the Civil Service should note that, if successful, their salary on appointment would be determined by the Departments transfer / promotion policies.


As a member of the DfE, you will be entitled to join the highly competitive Civil Service Pension Scheme, which many experts agree is one of the most generous in the UK.
  

  

You will have 25 days leave, increasing by 1 day every year to a maximum of 30 days after five years service. In addition, all staff receive the Kings Birthday privilege holiday and 8 days bank and public holidays.


We offer flexible working arrangements, such as job sharing, term\-time working, flexi\-time and compressed hours.


Most DfE employees will be working a hybrid pattern, spending at least 60% of their time in an office or work setting. Changes to these working arrangements are available in exceptional circumstances but must be agreed with the line manager and in line with the requirements of the role.


Travel to your primary office location will not be paid for by DfE, but costs for travel to an office which is not your main location will be covered.


As an organisation, which exists to support education and lifelong learning, we offer our staff excellent professional development opportunities.

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**

**Application/sift:**


At application you will be asked to provide your CV and a statement of suitability. Both should be anonymised (all personal information removed, such as your name, date of birth, gender, contact information, nationality etc).

* Your CV should include details of previous roles held and responsibilities / previous skills and experience.
* Your statement of suitability (max 1250 words) should demonstrate how you meet the essential criteria listed in the person specification section above.


Your CV and statement will be assessed together against the listed essential criteria.

**First stage interview:**


Longlisted candidates may be invited to attend a preliminary interview, typically involving a commitment of up to 1 hour.


The interview will consist of a series of questions to further assess the essential criteria for the role, focused on the first three essential criteria.


Interviews will be on MS teams, which may be remote or from a DfE office \- we will confirm which when you are invited to an interview.


If successful, candidates will then be invited to a second interview.

**Second stage interview**:


At this interview we will ask questions to further assess your experience in relation to all of the listed essential criteria.


This will be used to assess your experience against the essential (and in the case of a tie, the desirable) criteria.


Interviews will be on MS teams, which may be remote or from a DfE office \- we will confirm which when you are invited to an interview.

**Feedback**


Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview.

**Timing**


We expect to sift in week commencing 5 October 2026


First stage interviews will likely take place in the week commencing 19 October 2026\.


Second stage interviews will likely take place in the week commencing 2 November 2026\.


Once a provisional offer has been made, you will be invited to participate in a capability assessment to determine the value of the CBP allowance we can offer you. The assessment compares your skills against the Senior Technical Architect role described in DfEs local Technical Architecture Capability Framework, which is based on the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework.


Subject to your availability, we will aim to conduct the capability assessment and confirm the allowance offer to you within a week of the provisional offer being made.


This is a discretionary non\-consolidated, non\-pensionable allowance which, if awarded, is attached to the post. The value of the allowance is based on the outcome of a capability assessment and is reviewed annually. Allowance values range up to £19,400, with the highest values reserved for candidates whose capability is above the expected level for all of the skills.

**Other Information**


Interviews may be via Microsoft teams or face to face; the vacancy manager will confirm prior to the Interview.


In your application, please dont include personal information that identifies you.


This means we can recruit based on your knowledge and skills, and not background, gender or ethnicity \- it's called name blind recruitment .


Please ensure that you remove from your application, all references to your:

* name/title
* educational institutions
* age
* gender
* email address
* postal address
* phone number
* nationality/immigration status


We reserve the right to raise the minimum pass mark in the event of a high volume or strong field of candidates.


Please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK from the location options provided and not from overseas.


The government is committed to supporting apprenticeships, enabling people to learn and progress in a role whilst earning. We want to monitor the number of people who have completed apprenticeships who are now applying to progress further in their career and are asking this question to all candidates, on all vacancies. You will be asked a question as part of the application process about any previous apprenticeships you have completed. Your response to this question will not affect your application and it is not a requirement of the role to have completed a previous apprenticeship.


If successful and transferring from another Government Department a criminal record check maybe carried out.


In order to process applications without delay, we will be sending a Criminal Record Check to Disclosure and Barring Service on your behalf. However, we recognise in exceptional circumstance some candidates will want to send their completed forms direct. If you will be doing this, please advise Department of Education of your intention by emailing Pre\-Employment.Checks.DFE@education.gov.uk stating the job reference number in the subject heading.


Department for Education do not cover the cost of travel to your interview/assessment unless otherwise stated.


A reserve list may be held for a period of 12 months from which further appointments can be made.


Candidates will be posted in merit order based upon location preference. Where more than one location is advertised you will be asked to state your preferred location.


New entrants are expected to join on the minimum of the pay band.


Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre\-employment screening subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicants details held on the IFD will be refused employment.

Staff appointed on lateral transfer will move on to pre\-modernised DfE terms (unless they were on modernised terms in their previous organisation). Staff appointed on promotion will move on to modernised DfE terms. This job is broadly open to the following groups:


* UK nationals

* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre\-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)

jobs.title: Senior / Principal HV Electrical Engineer ( Buildings)
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineering
UKIMEA Region

LON000577 Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
Arup is an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services. Independent in ownership and spirit, we combine innovative digital solutions and processes with our domain expertise across the built environment to make a positive difference to the world.
Arup’s electrical engineers bring specialist expertise to solutions for buildings, transport infrastructure and energy, water and waste utilities. Our comprehensive services include energy audits, demand assessment, supply and system resilience, utilities consultancy and sustainable electrical engineering design.
Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!
**The Opportunity**
This role offers an excellent opportunity for a talented Principal HV Electrical Engineer to help shape the future direction of our growing London‑based team. You’ll work within a specialist HV group delivering technically challenging projects across sectors, from national‑significance infrastructure and international data‑centre power systems to renewable microgrid strategies, airport MV studies and major building HV design. With electrical engineering central to the transition to net‑zero, we’re looking for someone inquisitive, forward‑thinking and ready to challenge convention. You’ll operate as a key member of a multidisciplinary team, contributing to global projects and working in a collaborative, flexible environment. As a principal engineer, you’ll lead the planning and delivery of technical designs from inception to completion, producing and coordinating reports, studies, models and specifications while mentoring junior engineers. The role is client‑facing, requiring confident leadership of project teams, responsibility for financial performance and the ability to deliver high‑quality outcomes.
Responsibilities include leading HV and MV network design and optimisation; delivering detailed power‑system studies; developing earthing and substation layouts; coordinating multidisciplinary interfaces; reviewing contractor and vendor submissions; supporting procurement of HV/MV equipment; liaising with clients, utilities and regulators; and preparing clear technical documentation and presentations for stakeholders.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
**Is this role right for you?**
We are looking for people who bring technical excellence and a passion for engineering innovation. If you thrive on solving complex challenges and want to make a real impact, this could be the perfect opportunity.
**We are looking for people with the following:**
* Qualifications \& Professional Registration: Degree in Electrical Engineering (or related discipline) and professional registration with an institution such as IET or CIBSE.
* Technical Expertise: Deep domain knowledge in electrical engineering and strong understanding of British and IEC standards (BS 7671, BS 7430, BS 5839, BS 9999, BS EN 50522, IEC 60909, IEC 61936, IEC 60287\).
* Software \& Design Skills: Proficiency in electrical design tools such as ETAP, DigSILENT, CDEGS, Cymcap, PSCAD, and Trimble ProDesign.
* Protection \& Control Systems: Strong understanding of protection principles and schemes including grading studies and coordination; unit protection (REF, SEF, BED); busbar protection; directional overcurrent (DOC); CT/VT supervision; breaker failure protection; auto\-reclose schemes; and ability to perform protection calculations and relay setting coordination. Also, good knowledge of SCADA architecture, protocols (IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3\), control diagrams, network topologies, and interface requirements.
* Professional Attributes: Excellent communication skills, ability to build relationships internally and externally, commitment to continuous professional development, and enthusiasm for challenging engineering work.
Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact Louise Raisbeck (Louise.Raisbeck@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.  

**What we offer you**
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.  

**Different People, Shared Values**
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at http://www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.  

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Louise.Raisbeck (Louise.Raisbeck@arup.com) to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.  

**Our Application Process**
To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment\-process/
Stay safe online \- Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.  

Recruitment Agencies \- We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list  

Closing Date \- 2nd April 2026 \- We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early
