jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som . NET utvecklare**


Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.


Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

**Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:**

* Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
* Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
* Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
* Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
* Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.


Som .NET\-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**

* utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
* arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
* testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
* hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
* arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
* samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
* bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.


Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk \& Hälsa.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET\-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.


Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.


Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.


Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.


Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.


Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Patric Wu på patric.wu@skandia.se. Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.


Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

**Mer om IT**


Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!


Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand\-ups, team\-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.


Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200\+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.


We're looking for an experienced **AI\-First Senior Software Engineer** for our Stockholm office.


This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software *engineers*, not software *developers*. AI has hyper\-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade\-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.


Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and *sustainable* software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

**What you'll do**

* **System design.** Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
* **Domain modelling.** Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the *right* solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
* **Architectural patterns.** Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade\-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
* **Process design — the core responsibility.** Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as *orchestrator–worker* (an orchestrator decides sub\-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and *evaluator–optimizer* (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
* **Quality judgment.** Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line\-by\-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
* **Tooling — the right tool for the job.** Fluency across product\-development tools, AI\-acceleration (code\-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality\-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well\-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
* **Accountability.** You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

**Your profile**

* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non\-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
* An early adopter of AI\-first development, with **proven, in\-production experience implementing AI\-first software development processes** — not just experimenting with tooling
* Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI\-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow\-vs\-agent decisions)
* Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
* Test design, feedback\-loop design and validation skills over line\-by\-line review
* Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI\-accelerated pipelines
* Infrastructure / CI\-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
* Domain\-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
* Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
* Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
* Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

**Tools you'll work with**

* **AI\-acceleration:** Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
* **Languages \& engineering:** .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code\-review practice
* **Workflow orchestration:** agent frameworks and multi\-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
* **Infrastructure:** CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Quality control:** automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI\-assisted output

**Meritorious**

* Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
* Experience standing up AI\-first processes at team or organisation scale
* LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
* Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
* Prior consulting or client\-facing delivery experience

**What this role is not**


It is not a prompt\-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase *less* reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

**We're looking for someone who is**

* Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
* Accountable and self\-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
* Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail\-over and redundancy, because AI burn\-out is real)
* Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

**With us you get**

* A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
* A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
* A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

**Selected benefits**

* Opportunity for part\-ownership
* Competitive fixed salary
* 30 days holiday
* Company laptop, phone and subscription


Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.


Engineering judgement, accelerated — that's how we make IT easy.

jobs.title: CRM Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
Aurobay develops and produces world\-class hybrid engines and transmissions. With factories on two continents \- Sweden and China \- we're a pioneering global supplier of propulsion technology, development services and contract manufacturing. The Aurobay brand brings together over 9,000 dedicated and determined people that design, develop, and manufacture next\-generation powertrain solutions for a global market.


Aurobay is part of HORSE Powertrain Limited, a global leader in powertrain solutions. The Group has 19,000 employees, 17 plants and 5 R\&D centers across three continents. We partner with OEM customers around the world and offer innovative solutions that can cater to up to 80% of the growing hybrid and combustion powertrain market, enabling a faster transition toward cleaner mobility.


At Aurobay, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that different perspectives and experiences make for a stronger, more innovative company.


We are looking for a CRM Solutions Developer who combines hands\-on software development with strong experience in CRM platforms such as Hubspot or SalesForce, Power Platform, Azure, APIs, and system integrations. The role develops and maintains end\-to\-end CRM solutions that support sales processes, reliable customer data, and efficient integrations across the enterprise application landscape.


You will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and IT specialists to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and user\-friendly technical solutions. The position suits a communicative and structured developer who is comfortable taking responsibility from requirements and solution design through development, deployment, support, and continuous improvement.


﻿

**Key Responsibilities and Scope**

* Develop, configure, and maintain solutions in our CRM system and Power Platform.
* Build CRM functionality supporting lead management, prospecting, opportunities, activities, sales documentation, and follow\-up processes.
* Design and implement integrations between CRM, ERP, and other business systems using REST APIs, Azure services, and event\-driven patterns.
* Develop server\-side functionality, as well as client\-side functionality.
* Create and maintain Power Automate flows for automated and event\-triggered business processes.
* Contribute to customer data quality, harmonization, and golden\-record capabilities.
* Gather and refine technical requirements in dialogue with business stakeholders and convert them into maintainable solutions.
* Participate in solution design and architecture, applying clean architecture and domain\-driven design principles where appropriate.
* Use CI/CD, source control, and DevOps practices to support reliable development and deployment.
* Develop and integrate CPQ capabilities supporting product configuration, pricing, approvals, quote generation, and sales follow\-up.
* Design integrations between CRM, CPQ, PLM, ERP, and costing systems, including product structures, configuration rules, BOMs, pricing, and lifecycle changes.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve applications and integrations, including incident resolution and application support.
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute to secure, compliant, and well\-governed solutions.
* Collaborate within agile product teams and support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


﻿

**Skill requirements**

* Strong knowledge of various CRM concepts, and common data structures such as accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and activities.
* Practical knowledge of React, .NET, Azure, SQL, REST APIs, Power Platform, Power Automate, and TypeScript.
* Knowledge of CPQ concepts and CPQ\-to\-PLM integration, including product configuration, BOMs, pricing rules, master\-data ownership, synchronization, and traceability.
* Understanding of integration design, event\-driven solutions, authentication, data flows, and error handling.
* Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, Git\-based workflows, clean architecture, and automated deployment.
* Understanding of agile development methods such as Scrum, Kanban, and DevOps.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining CRM systems and Power Platform solutions.
* Experience building applications and integrations using Azure services.
* Experience working across the solution lifecycle, from requirements and design to implementation, deployment, maintenance, and support.
* Experience collaborating with business stakeholders and translating operational needs into technical solutions.
* Experience from complex or multi\-market organizations is an advantage.
* Knowledge of ERP integrations, Azure API Management, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, or GitOps is an advantage.

**Skills**

* Hands\-on, curious, and solution\-oriented with a strong interest in learning and continuous development.
* Strucured and detail\-oriented, with focus on quality, maintainability, and business value.
* Clear communicator who can bridge technical complexity and user needs.
* Collaborative and proactive, while also able to independently drive smaller initiatives and solve problems.
* Comfortable working in evolving technical environments with several systems and stakeholders.
* Fluent in English.
* Swedish is an advantage.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.


Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.


Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.


**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.


Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.


Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Patric Wu på patric.wu@skandia.se. Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.


Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


**Mer om IT**


Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!


Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand\-ups, team\-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.


Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer | SEB, Solna
jobs.description:
Low\-code is a way for a bank to move fast without cutting corners. Our team makes that possible. Join us in the Power Platform team, where we work with platform adoption, governance and support, to make sure good ideas don’t end up gathering dust on a shelf or take a year to reach production.



SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fuelled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating for a sustainable society and building the tech arena of the future, a welcoming space for everyone. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity!  

  

**About the role:**  

As a Power Platform developer in our Center of Excellence, you join a team that owns the platform end to end. We handle administration and governance on the platform, and we work with business units across the bank to help them build apps, automations and AI agents that support our transformation journey.



This is a developer role, but expect to spend a lot of time alongside other teams rather than in your own backlog. You will help projects and initiatives to succeed by providing support, guidance and training. Some weeks that might mean co\-building, other weeks it could mean workshops, and sometimes it’s an honest conversation about why something shouldn’t be built the way it’s been drawn up.

  

**In this role you will:**



* Run enablement in practice: workshops, templates, reusable patterns, development standards, and the maker community around them
* Guide business teams through their Power Platform work, from first idea to a solution they can own and maintain themselves
* Help teams make solutions safe and compliant by default, covering environment strategy, DLP, access, agent grounding and data handling, and explain the reasoning behind it
* Contribute to how the CoE itself runs: tooling, monitoring and the platform standards we ask the bank to follow
* Follow where the platform is heading, and translate that into practical guidance for our makers
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation in automation development
  


  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**



* Hands\-on experience building and developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform
* Experience with Copilot Studio or comparable agent tooling
* Some scripting or pro\-code background such as PowerShell, C\# or JavaScript, enough to extend the platform when low\-code runs out
* Automation experience (i.e., RPA, PowerShell, CI/CD or any cloud\-based automation tool, etc.)
* Familiarity with Azure Cloud services
* The ability to teach. You can take someone from confused to confident without taking over their keyboard
* Strong communication skills and comfort working with stakeholders at varying levels of technical fluency
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in English, written and spoken
  


  

**What we offer:**



* Agile and modern ways of working
* A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
* Extensive training and learning opportunities
* Work\-life balance
**Do you want to be part of SEB?**  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  

  

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026\-10\-05\. If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.



During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.  

SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.  

  

Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

**Job Description**

**Technical Architect, AI\-Powered Customer Experience**
--------------------------------------------------------

  

### **Why This Role? Why Now?**

  

Customer experience is being transformed by AI\-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we’re not just responding to that shift — we’re leading it. As we expand our AI\-powered Resolution Platform and deepen our Professional Services capabilities, the Technical Architect, AI\-Powered Customer Experience role is critical to helping customers design, implement, and scale intelligent customer service solutions that deliver measurable business value.  

  

  



As a technical expert, solution designer, and trusted advisor, you will help customers translate business goals into scalable AI\-first architectures. You’ll lead discovery, shape solution strategy, remove technical roadblocks, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Zendesk AI capabilities.  

  

  



### **Overarching Objective for the Role**

Accelerate customers’ time\-to\-value by designing and enabling AI\-first Zendesk solutions that drive adoption, automation, and measurable business impact from discovery through scale.


Be the customer’s AI technical architect. Turn business goals into the right architecture, integrations, workflows, and AI design choices.


Lead high\-quality solution discovery and delivery. Run technical discovery sessions, define solution scope, and guide customers through implementation with clarity and confidence.


Remove blockers fast. Anticipate risks, resolve constraints, and keep customer solutions moving toward successful outcomes.  

  

  

  



### **How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

Strategic Accountabilities


* AI Solution Architecture: Design scalable, supportable, and secure AI\-first architectures that enable automation, self\-service, agent assist, intelligent routing, and other Zendesk AI use cases.
* AI Adoption Enablement: Guide customers through rollout planning, change considerations, and operational readiness to support long\-term AI adoption while leveraging AI tools to enhance individual and team workflows for greater efficiency.
* Outcome Orientation: Ensure solution decisions are tied to measurable improvements in containment, deflection, productivity, resolution speed, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Technical Discovery \& Use Case Definition: Lead customer\-facing discovery sessions to understand business challenges, technical constraints, and high\-value AI opportunities.
* Customer Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed decisions about architecture, integrations, data readiness, and implementation tradeoffs.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Professional Services to align on customer strategy, risks, dependencies, and roadmap considerations.

Problem Solving \& Innovation: Diagnose product gaps, technical constraints, or workflow limitations and recommend validated workarounds or design alternatives that preserve business outcomes.

* Problem Solving: Strong analytical thinking and practical judgment to evaluate tradeoffs and recommend solutions that work in the real world.

Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current on Zendesk capabilities, AI trends, customer service transformation, and modern integration patterns.  
*

Required

* Experience with AI\-powered service tools, automation platforms, or conversational AI solutions such as Decagon, Forethought, Ada, or similar

Fluency in English and German, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and executive audiences

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Transactional Data Storage
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business\-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest\-throughput services at the company.  

  

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next\-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage\-format\-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud\-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high\-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission\-critical OLTP database platform.
* Collaborate with Principal Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read\-path caching, and backpressure under load.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production\-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
* Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
* Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high\-throughput services reliable, and participate in on\-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root\-cause resolution.

  

A day in the life  

You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage\-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade\-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads\-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production.  

  

About the team  

Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next\-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience in development in the last 3 years
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems
* Knowledge of databases, storage and big data concepts
* Experience with performance and scalability testing

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

jobs.title: Release Train Architect - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Jyväskylä, Finland


* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

**About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

  

**About the role**


We are now looking for **a Release Train Architect (RTA)** to work with **Tieto Caretech** healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

 **In this role you will**

* Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
* Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
* Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
* Apply hands\-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full\-stack solutions.
* Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event\-driven architecture.

 **We are looking for someone with**

* 10\+ years of experience in the software industry.
* Proficiency in **both** **English** and **Finnish** languages.

Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.  
* 

**It would be beneficial if you also have**

* Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
* Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test\-Driven Development.
* Familiarity with C\#, Angular, C\+\+, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
* Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
* Awareness of cross\-browser compatibility and web standards.
* Understanding of OpenEHR.
* Experience in the healthcare domain.
* Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7\.

  

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting\-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

  

**AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**


With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer – Embedded & Application
jobs.description:
Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem\-solvers focused on innovation, and looking to change the world. We are changing the paradigm for treating diseases such as prostate cancer by using real\-time MR Imaging, thermal ultrasound and close\-loop temperature feedback control, to gently ablate the diseased tissue with minimal side effects.  



  

If you share our values and want to work in a collaborative results focused culture and want to make a Profound impact in healthcare and your career, here is your chance.  



  

Are you a developer searching for a job which makes a difference, or saves lives? Would you like to join us in developing novel, incision\-free alternatives to traditional surgical treatments?  



  

**General Accountability**  



We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to work across our integrated software platform – from the real\-time embedded components close to the hardware, through to the Windows therapy console the clinical team relies on. You will collaborate closely with both software and hardware developers, as well as with our clinical team, to upgrade the architecture and expand our offering to new clinical applications.  



  

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**  



* Design, program, integrate, and verify embedded software using C/C\+\+, including work with RTOS (Yocto Linux) and communication interfaces to other system components.
* Develop therapy console and desktop application software in C\#/C\+\+, including graphical user interfaces built on .NET and/or Qt frameworks.
Design and implement comprehensive unit tests and use test\-automation tools to ensure high code quality and reliability.  
* 

  

**Education \& Certifications**  



Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.  

* 

  

**Key Attributes**

* Several years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of owning technical solutions end to end.
* Experience with hands\-on embedded software development in complex systems.
* Familiarity of windows platform, with knowledge of multi\-threaded applications and graphical user interface development.
Experience using scripting languages, e.g. Python, to boost development and testing.  
* 

  

**Considered an asset**

* Experience with developing software for medical devices.
* Experience with Yocto Linux and Altera / Intel Nios® soft processors.
Ability to read and review schematics.  
* 

  

***We thank you for your interest in Profound Medical. Please note only candidates that are short\-listed will be contacted.***  



  

***We strive to promote diversity and equal opportunity in the workplace and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require.***

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (API for Cloud Networking)
jobs.description:
**Do you want to create new networking products and craft clean APIs that enable customers to better use the Akamai Cloud?**

**Are you a software engineering enthusiast who loves solving complex problems?**

**Join our Cloud Networking Products team!**

Akamai Cloud is the world's most distributed cloud platform. Our customers range from frontier AI companies to scale\-ups and established market leaders.We are looking for a new colleague to join our API team in the Cloud Networking Products division.


**Partner with the best**

Join us in shaping the next generation of cloud computing. This role provides an opportunity to make a significant impact on Akamai's growing cloud offerings. You must have a passion to get things done quickly and get them done right.


As a Software Engineer Senior, you will be responsible for:


* Helping build out cloud platform functionality that sets up, manages, and protects networking in the Akamai Cloud.
* Designing and implementing clean, robust and performant REST APIs used by customers and internal teams.
* Developing and maintaining internal libraries and microservices used by various teams in Akamai.
* Designing, implementing, reviewing, documenting, and testing high quality Python code in close collaboration with your team.
* Reviewing and contributing to architectural and design documents authored by other teams.

**Do what you love**

To be successful in this role you will:


* Have background with mainstream programming languages, such as Python, Java, C\#, or Go.
* Have solid skills in writing, testing and understanding complex software.
* Have experience in designing and implementing REST APIs.
* Be experienced in technical design, product specifications reviews, projects and backlog planning.
* Be able to work productively with team members to identify and resolve issues in a collaborative manner.
* Have good communication skills, and experience in communicating with leadership and non\-developer stakeholders.
* Be experienced in mentoring other developers.

Some of the tools and frameworks we use are Python, docker, pytest, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, Flask, Prometheus and Grafana. While we don't expect you to have experience with all of them, curiosity and a willingness to learn is a must. Experience with developing microservices is a nice bonus. We are a team with a diverse background and while the majority of the team members are located in Denmark, our main working language is English.


**About us**

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
  

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
  

  

Our focus is simple:
  

**Cloud and Edge:** Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
  

**Security** : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
  

**Content Delivery** : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
  

**AI** : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
  

  

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.


**Benefits at Akamai:** We support your health, well\-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.


**FlexBase adapts to your job's needs**

jobs.title: Full Stack Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

* Design and implement back\-end services in modern C\+\+(C\+\+17/20\) and C\#/.NET, including relational schema design, query optimization, transaction handling, and middleware integration; expose and consume interfaces over TCP/IP, REST, WebSocket, gRPC, and serial communication
* Develop Front\-end applications with angular and Vue, covering component architecture, state management, and reactive data flow, for both server\-side clients and machine\-mounted HMI and kiosk clients
* Develop and maintain cross\-compiled embedded C\+\+software for ARM64 Linux targets
* Work hands\-on with single\-board computer platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson): device setup and connectivity, Linux environment configuration, and deploying and troubleshooting software on target hardware
* Perform root\-cause analysis of failures on real machines and in the field using structured logs, traces, timing measurements, crash dumps, and hardware documentation, then design and implement the softwarefix, the recovery behavior, and the regression test
* Contribute to technical specifications: identify gaps, ambiguities, and conflicts in incomplete requirements, raise them withstakeholders early, and author traceable requirements documentation(SWRD\-style, with ticket\-linked requirement IDs) covering functional, interface, performance, and error\-handling requirements
* Design and develop product features together with mechanical, electrical, and software teams across several countries; run design and code reviews, verification and validation activities, and technical evaluation of third\-party components including bench testing
* Contribute to computer vision, image processing, and3D vision work for automated inspection (camera and illumination interfacing, calibration, feature extraction and measurement, and AI/ML\-assisted defect classification); prior experience is welcome but not required, and training will be provided.


Job Requirements
  
  

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field


Work experience
  
  

* ≥3 years' experience in full\-stack software development, including products released to customers and maintained across multiple release cycles (fresh graduates also welcome to apply if relevant experience shown)


Expertise and methodology
  
  

* Product development and use of development tools: Visual Studio Professional/Code, static analysis, AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude Code)
* Programming languages: modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20, STL, templates, smart pointers); C\#/.NET is good to have but not required
* Front\-end development — Angular or Vue preferred; candidates with React or strong TypeScript experience are also considered, provided they are willing to learn Angular and Vue: component architecture, state management, reactive and observable data flow, and build tooling
* Multi\-threaded and concurrent programming
* Databases: relational schema design, SQL, indexing, and transaction handling from C\+\+ and C\#
* Communication technology: familiarity with TCP/IP, REST, WebSocket, gRPC, and serial communication; awareness of interface versioning and backward compatibility
* Unit, integration, and regression testing, and Design for testability
* Debugging and root\-cause analysis on real hardware: log and trace analysis, reproducing intermittent and timing\-dependent faults
* Version control (Git): branching and merging strategies, and code review
* Software Development Life Cycle, with basic understanding of Agile methodologies and lifecycle models
* Proficient and disciplined use of AI coding assistants to accelerate development, while maintaining full understanding, code quality, and accountability for all code produced
* Good to have:


o Basic working knowledge of Jira and Confluence for issue tracking, sprint work, and technical documentation
  
  

**o Embedded, cross\-compiled C\+\+ development for ARM64 Linux:** toolchains, sysroots, cross\-debugging, and hardware abstraction
  
  

o Single\-board computer platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson): setup, connectivity, and working in a Linux environment on target hardware
  
  

o Basic microcontroller and firmware knowledge (e.g., STM32 or similar): peripherals (GPIO, UART, SPI, I²C) and interrupt handling
  
  

o Computer vision, image processing, and 3D vision (e.g., OpenCV, point cloud processing)
  
  

o Python
  
  

Other requirement
  
  

* Communication skills (verbal and written), including presenting and defending technical designs to non\-software engineers
* Social competences to work in cross\-cultural andinternational environment
* Sense of ownership and responsibility for assignedwork, including its quality after release
* Diligence and attention to detail in released software
* Goal\-driven and independent working style
* Willingness to learn and openness to feedback
* Willingness to travel internationally to customer sites and other Komax locations


Komax
  
  

– leading the field now and in the future
  
  

As a pioneer and market leader in the field of automated wire processing, Komax provides its customers with innovative and sustainable solutions for any situation that calls for precise contact connections.
  
  

Komax manufactures series and customer\-specific machinery for various industries, catering for every degree of automation and customization. 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Iași, Romania
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high\-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work\-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  

  

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well\-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  

  

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed\-systems scope varying by team.
  

  

Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  

  

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  

  

Use GenAI and AI\-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI\-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  

  

Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  

  

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on\-call duties.
  

  

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  

  

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from a technical internship
* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About Qualysoft**

* 25 years of experience in software engineering, established in Vienna, Austria


* Active in Romania since 2007, with office in central Bucharest (Bd. Iancu de Hunedoara 54B)


* Delivering End to End IT Consulting Services \- From Team Augmentation and Dedicated Teams to Custom Software Development
* We deliver scalable enterprise systems, intelligent automation frameworks, and digital transformation platforms


* Cross\-industry experience by sustaining global players in BSFI (Banking, financial services and insurance), Telecom,Retail \& E\-commerce, Energy and Utilities, Automotive, Manufacturing, Logitics, High Tech


* Global Presence: Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Sweden, Hungary, Slovakia, Serbia, Romania, and Indonesia


* International team of 500\+ software engineers


* Strategic partnerships: Microsoft Cloud Certified Partner, Tricentis Solutions Partner in Test Automation and Test Management, Creatio Exclusive Partner, Doxee Implementation Partner


* Powered by cutting\-edge technologies: AI, Data \& Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, IoT, and Test Automation.


* Project beneficiaries ranging from large\-scale enterprises to startups


* Stable growth and revenue increase year over year, a resilient organisation in volatile IT market conditions


* Quality\-first mindset, culture of innovation, and long\-term client partnerships


* Global and local reach – trusted by key industry players in Europe and the US



### **Responsibilities**

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer with a strong API testing and automation background to join our Loan Processor team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable test automation solutions, ensuring the quality of complex lending workflows, integrations, and microservices that support the loan origination and processing lifecycle.
* The role requires hands\-on experience with API automation frameworks, test strategy definition, CI/CD integration, and collaboration with developers, business analysts, and product owners in an Agile environment.



Test Automation
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for API and backend services.


* Develop reliable automated tests covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end scenarios.


* Review and improve existing automation suites to increase maintainability and execution efficiency.


* Define automation standards, best practices, and coding guidelines.



API \& Backend Testing
* Validate RESTful APIs, event\-driven integrations, and microservices.


* Design comprehensive API test scenarios covering:


* Functional validation


* Negative testing


* Error handling


* Security validation


* Performance considerations


* Data consistency


* Perform contract and integration testing across multiple systems.


* Analyze API payloads, logs, and system interactions to identify defects.



 Quality Engineering
* Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify risks early.


* Define test strategies and coverage for new features.


• Ensure adequate test coverage for critical loan processing business flows. • Support shift\-left testing practices.

CI/CD \& DevOps
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.


* Monitor and improve test execution reliability.


* Support deployment validation and production readiness activities.


* Provide quality metrics and automation reports to project stakeholders.



Leadership \& Collaboration
* Conduct code reviews and contribute to automation framework enhancements.


* Collaborate closely with development, architecture, product, and operations teams.


* Drive continuous improvement across QA practices and processes.

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of QA Automation experience.


* 3\+ years of API test automation experience.


* Experience testing enterprise applications with multiple integrations.


* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


* Strong knowledge of: REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS


• Authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, Basic Auth) • Swagger/OpenAPI • Experience with: RestAssured, Postman/Insomnia, Similar API automation tools • Strong hands\-on experience with C\#
* Automation Frameworks


* Experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks using:


* TestNG / JUnit / NUnit / xUnit CI/CD


* Experience with:


* Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git



Additionally
* Experience with microservices architecture.


* Experience using test management and defect tracking tools (Jira, Xray, Zephyr).


* Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) is a plus.

 **What We Offer**

* Premium medical package


* Lunch Tickets \& Pluxee Card


* Bookster subscription


* 13th salary/yearly bonuses


* Enterprise job security with a startup mentality (diverse \& engaging environment, international exposure, flat hierarchy) under the stability of a secure multinational


* A supportive culture (we value ownership, autonomy, and healthy work\-life balance) with great colleagues, team events and activities


* Flexible working program and openness to remote work


* Collaborative mindset – employees shape their own benefits, tools, team events and internal practices


* Diverse opportunities in Software Development with international exposure


* Flexibility to choose projects aligned with your career path and technical goals


* Access to leading learning platforms, courses, and certifications (Pluralsight, Udemy, Microsoft, Google Cloud)


* Career growth \& learning – mentorship programs, certifications, professional development opportunities, and above\-market salary

  

**\*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment decisions are made without regard to age, gender, disability, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.\***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Asp.net/C# - Software Architect
jobs.description:
**About Kairostek**
===================


At Kairostek, we believe great technology starts with great people.


We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our team to make a meaningful impact while building solutions that shape the future. Our teams work across software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital products, payments technology, and technology operations to deliver scalable and innovative solutions for global organizations.


If you are passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.

**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for an experienced Software Architect with 10\+ years of software engineering experience and 3\+ years of architectural/technical leadership experience to drive the design and evolution of scalable iGaming and eGaming platforms.


The ideal candidate has strong expertise in C\#/.NET, microservices, DDD, TDD, cloud\-native architecture, and hands\-on experience with online casino, game provider, aggregator, wallet, and eGaming integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Design and lead scalable C\#/.NET microservices and distributed systems.
* Define domain boundaries and architecture using DDD, clean architecture, and event\-driven patterns.
* Architect casino and eGaming integrations, including game providers, aggregators, wallets, payments, and third\-party platforms.
* Design reliable gaming transaction flows such as Bet, Win, Rollback, Balance, and Game Session.
* Champion TDD, automated testing, code quality, and engineering best practices.
* Design cloud\-native solutions using Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Redis.
* Define and improve CI/CD, DevOps, observability, scalability, and system resilience.
* Lead architecture decisions, technical design reviews, and mentor engineering teams.
* Work closely with Product and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 3\+ years as a Software Architect, Solution Architect, Principal Engineer, or Technical Lead.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in C\#/.NET and ASP.NET Core.
* Strong experience with Microservices, DDD, TDD, REST APIs, and event\-driven architecture.
* Strong iGaming experience is required, particularly online casino and game provider integrations.
* Experience with casino aggregators, wallets, payments, player platforms, or gaming APIs.
* Strong Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD experience.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive compensation package.
* Flexible and remote\-friendly work environment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.
* Exposure to international projects and teams.
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.
* Opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================


Kairostek is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background.

jobs.title: Business Applications & Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Neptune Lines Shipping and Managing Enterprises (Neptune Lines), part of Neptune Group**, is a leading finished vehicle logistics provider, specializing in transportation and shipping solutions for manufacturers and shippers of cars and high and heavy cargoes. Operating across Europe, North Africa, and the Black Sea, Neptune Lines excels in short\-sea shipping, connecting ports with efficient and specialized services. As a trusted partner for major car manufacturers, Neptune Lines delivers tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards. Guided by its "Wake Forward" philosophy, Neptune Lines is committed to sustainability, reliability, and customer satisfaction, delivering operational excellence that drives progress in the logistics industry.

  

  

We are seeking a talented and tech\-savvy **Business Applications \& Support Engineer** to join our **Digital Transformation team**. You will play a key role in supporting, optimizing and continuously enhancing our core business systems and ERP applications. Acting as a vital link between technology, business operations, end\-users and external vendors, you will translate business needs into effective digital solutions, oversee system improvements and contribute to the successful delivery of transformation initiatives.

  

  

The position reports directly to the **Digital Transformation Manager**.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze, support and enhance core business systems and enterprise applications, including ERP systems, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and business requirements.
* Design and develop tailored in\-house applications or custom scripts, as required, to address specific business needs.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal end\-users and external software vendors, facilitating effective communication and accelerating issue resolution.
* Oversee system installations, upgrades and configurations carried out by external vendors, ensuring timely, efficient and high\-quality project delivery.
* Design and execute comprehensive end\-to\-end testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure system reliability and seamless performance.
* Deliver engaging training sessions and develop clear user documentation to support end\-users and promote the successful adoption of new technologies.
* Develop and deliver a wide range of reports, dashboards and data insights, supporting business continuity and providing Top Management with valuable information for decision\-making.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**


* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience: At least two years of relevant professional experience in application support, business analysis, ERP implementation or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English (a third language will be considered an asset).
  

  

**Skills**


* Strong hands\-on knowledge of relational database management systems, with particular emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL.
* Familiarity with at least one major programming language, such as Python, C\#, Java, PHP or VB.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Greek and English, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* A proactive and collaborative team player who can also work independently, quickly adapt to emerging technologies and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Experience with Business Intelligence tools, such as Power BI or QlikView, and the ability to transform raw data into meaningful and actionable dashboards will be considered an asset.
* Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and workflow automation tools, such as Power Automate or UiPath, will be considered an asset.
  

  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to ensuring that our employment practices do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other legally protected status. By applying, you agree to the Consent Form for the Processing of Personal Data(GDPR). More information can be found at: https://www.neptunelines.com/consent\-form\-processing\-personal\-data

jobs.title: Frenden Technical Architect
jobs.description:
22\-09\-2026


Brussels


**Frontend Technical Architect**
--------------------------------


Voor een organisatie in de financiële sector zoeken we een **Frontend Technical Architect** die technische richting geeft aan de ontwikkeling van webapplicaties. Je combineert een sterke kennis van Angular en .NET met architecturaal inzicht en de vaardigheid om ontwikkelteams te begeleiden.


**Wat ga je doen?**


* Je vertaalt functionele behoeften naar duurzame technische architecturen.
* Je bepaalt ontwikkelstandaarden, herbruikbare componenten en richtlijnen voor webapplicaties.
* Je adviseert meerdere teams over technische keuzes, beveiliging, prestaties en onderhoudbaarheid.
* Je beoordeelt de impact van technologische wijzigingen en helpt upgrades en technische schuld aan te pakken.
* Je documenteert architectuurbeslissingen en licht ze toe aan teams en besluitvormers.
* Je coacht ontwikkelaars en volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen, waaronder AI ondersteunde softwareontwikkeling.

**Wat breng je mee?**


* Ervaring als Technical Architect, Solution Architect of Senior Software Engineer in een complexe omgeving.
* Grondige kennis van **Angular** en moderne frontendontwikkeling, plus sterke kennis van **.NET/.NET Core**.
* Ervaring met webbeveiliging en authenticatiestandaarden zoals OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect en SAML.
* Ervaring met herbruikbare componenten, technische standaarden en schaalbare webapplicaties.
* Sterke communicatievaardigheden en een pragmatische aanpak.
* Vloeiend Nederlands óf Frans, met minstens een basiskennis van de andere taal.

Ervaring met design systems, CI/CD, architectuurgovernance of de financiële sector is een pluspunt.


**Praktisch:** start zo snel mogelijk · opdracht van 12 maanden, met mogelijke verlenging · Brussel centrum.

jobs.title: Développeur .Net Sénior H/F Consortia - Testing, Développement, Data & IA · Bruxelles · Hybride
jobs.description:
**Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group.**


Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs.


**C’est votre future équipe**


Mobilisée pour la réussite de ses clients, l’équipe de Consort Belgium incarne les valeurs et partage les expertises de Consort Group à Bruxelles, dans ses environs, et sur l’ensemble du territoire belge. Forte de 45 collaborateurs, elle propose depuis 2016 une offre de services en Infrastructures et Solutions Applicatives, portée par des équipes locales et appuyée, lorsque nécessaire, par les compétences et ressources du groupe.

  

  

**Développeur .Net Sénior** **H/F**


**C’est votre mission**


Vous êtes passionné·e par le **développement .NET et les architectures web modernes** ? Ce poste est fait pour vous.


En tant que **Développeur .NET / Blazor**, vous intégrez une équipe produit en charge de solutions **Portals \& Platforms**. Vous participez à la conception, au développement et à l’évolution d’applications critiques dans un environnement technologique exigeant, avec une forte utilisation de **.NET 8 et Blazor WebAssembly**.


Côté build :


* Concevoir et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités en **.NET 8 / C\#** et **Blazor WebAssembly**
* Développer des composants et services applicatifs robustes et maintenables
* Implémenter la couche d’accès aux données avec **Entity Framework Core**
* Concevoir et exploiter des bases de données **SQL Server** et **MongoDB**
* Mettre en œuvre des échanges asynchrones et des architectures orientées événements avec **RabbitMQ**
* Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions basées sur des **microservices**
* Écrire et maintenir les tests automatisés selon une approche **TDD**
* Veiller à la qualité, la performance et la maintenabilité du code produit

Côté run :


* Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive des applications existantes
* Analyser et résoudre les incidents et problèmes techniques rencontrés sur les applications
* Garantir la qualité et la stabilité des développements livrés
* Identifier les améliorations techniques permettant de renforcer la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des solutions
* Collaborer avec les équipes produit et techniques afin d'assurer la continuité et l'évolution des services

**C’est votre parcours**


Vous avez une expérience significative en **développement .NET**, idéalement dans des environnements applicatifs complexes. Vous aimez concevoir des solutions robustes, travailler sur des applications modernes et prendre en responsabilité vos développements de bout en bout.


Vous appréciez les environnements où la **qualité du code, les tests et la collaboration** occupent une place centrale.


**C’est votre expertise** **:**


* **.NET 8 / C\#**
* **Blazor WebAssembly**
* **Entity Framework Core**
* **SQL Server**
* **MongoDB**
* **RabbitMQ**
* **TDD et tests automatisés**
* Connaissance des **architectures microservices** appréciée
* La maîtrise du **français ou du néerlandais**, avec une compréhension passive de l'autre langue, est attendue. La maîtrise de **l'anglais** est également nécessaire.

Une expérience dans des environnements **Agile** et sur des applications à forte criticité constitue un atout.


**C’est votre manière de faire équipe** **:**


* Vous disposez de **bonnes capacités de communication** et savez collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs
